n07e21af93a.headline: Decline of the Czech economy is not tragic. The worst is behind, analysts say
n07e21af93a.summary: The Czech economy experienced a record decline in Q2 but analysts expect quarter-on-quarter growth in Q3, indicating the worst may be over.
n07e21af93a.why: The Czech Republic is a key Central European economy; its recovery trajectory impacts regional trade and investment flows.

n5424973872.headline: AMLO government reserves borrowing in case of coronavirus resurgence
n5424973872.summary: Mexico's Undersecretary of Finance stated the government would reserve borrowing tools to protect the economy if the COVID-19 recovery is prolonged or vaccines are delayed.
n5424973872.why: Mexico is a major emerging market economy, and its fiscal policy stance amid the pandemic affects investor confidence and regional economic stability.
